task_description: Write a method in Dafny to remove all whitespaces from the given string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method RemoveWhitespaces(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the returning string is equal to the number of non-whitespace characters in the input string
- The returned string contains no whitespace characters
- All non-whitespace characters from the input string are preserved in the output string in their original order
